<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"> <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion> <groupId>com.example</groupId> <artifactId>WebAppApache</artifactId> <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version> <packaging>war</packaging>
<properties> <!-- Control para ejecutar wsimport desde el POM o CLI. Cambiar a 'true' para saltarlo. --> <wsimport.skip>false</wsimport.skip> <maven.compiler.source>16</maven.compiler.source> <maven.compiler.target>16</maven.compiler.target> </properties>
<dependencies> <!-- Servlet API para Tomcat 11 (Jakarta EE 10) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.servlet</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.servlet-api</artifactId> <version>6.0.0</version> <scope>provided</scope> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>org.json</groupId> <artifactId>json</artifactId> <version>20240303</version> </dependency>
<!-- Jakarta Persistence API (JPA annotations and EntityManager) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId> <version>3.1.0</version> </dependency>
<!-- Jakarta Transactions API (if used) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.transaction</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.transaction-api</artifactId> <version>2.0.1</version> </dependency>
<!-- JSTL para JSP --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl-api</artifactId> <version>2.0.0</version> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.glassfish.web</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl</artifactId> <version>2.0.0</version> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId> <artifactId>gson</artifactId> <version>2.10.1</version> </dependency> <!-- Proyecto Swing local --> <dependency> <groupId>com.miempresa</groupId> <artifactId>MiProyectoSwing</artifactId> <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version> </dependency>
<!-- JAX-WS runtime moderno compatible con Jakarta y JDK 21 --> <dependency> <groupId>com.sun.xml.ws</groupId> <artifactId>rt</artifactId> <version>4.0.2</version> </dependency>
<!-- JAXB moderno para JDK 21 (Jakarta) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.xml.bind</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.xml.bind-api</artifactId> <version>4.0.2</version> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>com.sun.xml.bind</groupId> <artifactId>jaxb-impl</artifactId> <version>4.0.2</version> </dependency> </dependencies>
<build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.11.0</version> <configuration> <source>${maven.compiler.source}</source> <target>${maven.compiler.target}</target> </configuration> </plugin> <!-- add the extra source directory where your Logica/DataTypes live --> <plugin> <groupId>org.jvnet.jax-ws-commons</groupId> <artifactId>jaxws-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>2.6</version> <executions> <execution> <id>wsimport</id> <phase>generate-sources</phase> <goals><goal>wsimport</goal></goals> </execution> </executions> <configuration> <skip>${wsimport.skip}</skip> <verbose>true</verbose> <wsdlUrls> <wsdlUrl>http://localhost:8081/JuanViajes?wsdl</wsdlUrl> </wsdlUrls> <!-- Soporte adicional: procesar WSDL local bajo src/main/resources/wsdl --> <wsdlDirectory>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/wsdl</wsdlDirectory> <wsdlFiles> <wsdlFile>JuanViajes.wsdl</wsdlFile> </wsdlFiles> <packageName>com.example.wsdl</packageName> </configuration> </plugin>
</plugins> </build> </project>
